digest.title: Google will let schools skip AI tools, but they have to give up search, too
digest.tldr: Google will offer schools AI tools that purportedly don't give away the answers.

digest.title: Google dismantles botnet secretly running on 1.3 million Android TV boxes
digest.tldr: Google has cut ties with the company behind the botnet campaign.

digest.title: Google: LLMjacking attacks rack up $1 million in cloud AI charges
digest.tldr: Large language model hijacking attacks, also known as LLMjacking, are generating large fraudulent cloud charges, with some organizations losing more than $100,000 per day.

digest.title: Google Issues Patches for Critical Android Flaw That Could Allow RCE Without User Interaction
digest.tldr: A critical Android flaw could allow an attacker to run code on a phone without any user action remotely, Google said in its November security bulletin.  The flaw, CVE-2026-58868, affects Android 14 through 17.

digest.title: Agentic cheminformatics with Google Antigravity
digest.tldr: Learn how Google Antigravity and our Cheminformatics Skills accelerate drug discovery workflows, search compounds, and propose novel rigidified macrocycles.
